title: I prompted a dumb game in 15 mins...🤡🕹️
author: Annual-Wrongdoer-788
selftext:
https://reddit.com/link/1qybc8r/video/vj13k85522ig1/player

So, I got access to this invite-only AI game-dev engine and built this game...well,you can see the clip. Just for fun...the engine is till in private beta, and it's free now.

comments.body: Looks great! what did you use?

replies.author: Annual-Wrongdoer-788
replies.body: Thx! It's not open to the public yet, but if you're interested, I could reach out to the devs and see if I can snag an invite for you.

comments.author: Slackluster
comments.body:
As an experiment I remade the same game in only 15 minutes using LittleJS and copilot. I think I came pretty close. This is a completely free an opensource AI game generation system I am working on...

[https://killedbyapixel.github.io/LittleJS-AI/games/limbo.html](https://killedbyapixel.github.io/LittleJS-AI/games/limbo.html)

replies.author: ineedthealgorithm
replies.body: Could you share the prompt for this game? I'm going to try it with [Pixelfork](https://www.pixelfork.ai/) to see how it's going to be

replies.author: Slackluster
replies.body:
Yeah, that sounds fun! Here is my prompt and what the AI wrote back. I used voice mode so it is somewhat broken English. After that it was about 10 minutes fixing bugs and tweaking a few things...

>I want to create a new small game. That is kind of looks kind of like a limbo. With dark. Characters and in the background it will be kind of. Bluish nighttime with sky. It'll be raining too. Raining and. So that rain particles coming down from the sky and there are some rocks on the ground that you can pick up and throw. You're going to be a little person that's running around stick figure and there is also a tree. You're like on an island, a small island, and you can pick up rocks. You could throw them into the water or you can run jump to the water or you can. There's not really much else you can jump. You can pick up rocks and throw them.

comments.author: SmoggySPECTEREGaming
comments.body: That's a really impressive build in just 15 minutes. Would love to try it out once it's available.

replies.author: Annual-Wrongdoer-788
replies.body: i would like to share, but the prompts are extensive. i spent a while planning the logic in Gemini first, took some effort. Even though the prototype was created in 15 mins, i spent a lot more time fixing bugs afterward
